{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# https://help.github.com/en/categories/automating-your-workflow-with-github-actions

name: "Backward Compatibility Check"

on:
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  roave-backwards-compatibility-check:
    name: "Backward Compatibility Check"

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.operating-system }}

    strategy:
      matrix:
        dependencies:
          - "locked"
        php-version:
          - "8.5"
        operating-system:
          - "ubuntu-latest"

    steps:
      - name: "Checkout"
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: "Cache Composer dependencies"
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock', 'tools/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: "Install PHP"
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@2.40.0"
        with:
          php-version: "${{ matrix.php-version }}"
          ini-values: memory_limit=-1
          extensions: pdo_sqlite, bcmath, intl, sodium

      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: ${{ matrix.dependencies }}

      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: ${{ matrix.dependencies }}
          working-directory: 'tools'

      - name: "Check for BC breaks"
        run: "tools/vendor/bin/roave-backward-compatibility-check --format=github-actions --install-development-dependencies"",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs Composer dependency installation twice (root and tools/) on every pull request with no dependency cache, so repeated runs re-fetch packages. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache) applies: repeated dependency fetching is measurable, cache inputs include the lockfiles and runner OS, there is no existing equivalent cache, and the cached content is the locked, trusted Composer download cache rather than unchecked build outputs. Adding actions/cache@v4 keyed on composer.lock and tools/composer.lock preserves all build and test coverage, adds no privileged actions, secrets, publishing/deployment, or new network access, and does not weaken permissions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
